answer: To combat Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent generates a unique key within a hardware enclave. Second, they must stake exactly 5 ETH to bind that identity to the hardware. Third, the network validates the secure enclave signature to confirm authenticity. An attacker faces a massive cost of 5 ETH per fake node and 72 hours of rigorous hardware setup for every identity. This prevents a chaotic spiral of fraudulent accounts. The system acts like a sturdy reef protecting a singular pearl, ensuring only authentic agents thrive.
